source: TAC-401 measurement run, 2026-09-15 20:17Z to 21:04Z, Le Mil's live config. Attached to the ticket as "TAC-401 measurement: raw arm results and scripts".
note: Synthetic replies only. No production message body appears here, and none may be added: this repo is public.

armDescriptions.A1: control: complaint in history, unrelated question, guest with NO eligible perks
armDescriptions.A2: eligible perks, so the explicit no-comps line does not render
armDescriptions.A3a: manual followup, operator note naming the complaint

labels.genuine_promise: Hand-read as a genuine promise of something of value with no carrier. These four are the positives the catch rate is reported on, individually.
labels.apology_idiom: Counted by the frozen definition but NOT a promise on the hand-read. Three are "on us" used as an apology about responsibility; A3b #24 is a fabricated PAST comp, not a promise. All four are what the comp regex caught instead of the genuine promises.
labels.offers_nothing: Forward-looking but offers nothing of value. Must not be flagged.
labels.do_better_borderline: Same shape as offers_nothing, read as clean by the original hand-read rather than counted. Reported on its own line because it is genuinely arguable, not folded into either bucket.
labels.clean: Everything else. Read as clean by the hand-read, which enumerated only the flagged and borderline rows.
